items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: The young men's Christian endeavor, and the BYPU, and oh, boy, and that fire and brimstone really got me.

ctx.x: Well, one was Old Ship Church. That was an AME Church, African Methodist Episcopal, and my grandmother played in Mount Zion. That was a Baptist church. So that meant that I had to go to choir practice at both churches. The young men's Christian endeavor, and the BYPU, and oh, boy, and that fire and brimstone really got me. But --
